t: When Good AI Goes Bad: A Story of Regression and Recovery
s: This case study explores Pipulate's journey with AI coding assistants, detailing a shift from manual log sharing to agentic workflows. It highlights the benefits of 'Radical Transparency' and the creation of 'righteous positive feedback loops' enabled by AI tool access, despite initial regressions.
sub: Agentic AI workflows with tool access (grep, git, curl)
MCP (Magic Command Protocol) for AI endpoint interaction
Creating 'righteous positive feedback loops' for AI agency
